scope: Source code, existing geometry metadata and generated arrays/responses only; no experimental payload access.

independent_checks.version_scope: Generated numerical/support/HTTP/decoder checks were performed during draft review. Their checked routines are unchanged in the final inspected runner; final changes add the unique-order gate, fixed TIFF IFD pointer and dependency versions. New gate and pointer regression checks are separately recorded by the author.

acceptance_limits: A unique match establishes local consistency at four frozen rays with one declared rendering hypothesis, not whole-surface provenance or the physical ink-facing side.
The inverse-affine 5x5x5 integration approximates a nominal voxel footprint of the interpolated fine field; it does not reproduce the coarse acquisition PSF or noise.
All anatomy statistics remain descriptive within one physical fragment; no fitted affine, selected best shift, pixel-IID confidence interval or automatic label-stage approval.
Raw source chunks are mutable and not prehashed here. Execution must freeze HEAD ETags/lengths, enforce conditional retrieval, and record acquired SHA256 values.
